result.summary: Found 2 issues: a minor content alignment issue with truncated restaurant name and a minor accessibility concern regarding small text for delivery times.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section due to insufficient horizontal space within the card container.
issues.suggestion: Reduce font size slightly, increase card width, or implement text truncation with ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccolo...') to indicate continuation.

issues.description: Delivery time text (15-25 min, 20-30 min) on restaurant cards appears small against busy background images, potentially causing readability issues for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size or add a semi-transparent dark overlay behind the text badges to improve contrast and ensure WCAG compliance.
